title: Steamed Short-Grain Rice
summary: Stovetop method for sticky, separate-grained rice. Rinse, soak, steam, rest.

steps.title: Rinse
steps.text: Put the rice in a bowl, cover with cold water, swirl with your hand and pour off the cloudy water. Repeat until the water runs nearly clear, 4 or 5 changes.

steps.title: Soak
steps.text: Drain well. Combine the rice and measured water in a heavy pot with a tight lid and let it sit 20 minutes. Soaking is what gets the center cooked without the bottom scorching.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Bring to a boil over medium-high, uncovered, until you see big bubbles across the surface.

steps.title: Steam
steps.text: Cover, drop the heat to the lowest setting, and cook 15 minutes. Don't lift the lid.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Off the heat, still covered, rest 10 minutes. Then fluff gently with a paddle from the bottom up.

notes: Ratio is 1 cup rice to 1 1/8 cups water after soaking. If you have a rice cooker, use it; this is the no-cooker method.
